integrity_note: Proof explicitly invokes the known Hug mean-eight equality theorem, without claiming that prior expectation as new. The pointwise and Monte Carlo checker is corroborative, not a proof.
limitations: The converse is restricted to centrally symmetric hexagons with strictly obtuse angles. The probability law assumes cyclicity; generic interior points and exact area sampling. Historical priority is provisional, and the 1995 primary article was not inspected in full.
title: A three-atom normal law and a mod-four cyclicity criterion for centrally symmetric hexagons
